photag keeps its catalog (a database) and thumbnails in the library folder. OneDrive syncs those files while they change, which can cause sync conflicts and even a damaged catalog. It is safer to keep the library outside OneDrive (for example C:\Photag), or to pause OneDrive sync while photag is open. Your photos stay where they are until you change it.
